name: Kresnik Energy
desc:
Energy required to operate the Eye of Graeae.
Kresnik Energy can be restored either by entering the range of heat sources powered by Kresnik Kristall in Snezhnaya, or by collecting Kresnik Kristall during exploration.

value.text:
Interact with specific heat sources in Snezhnaya
Obtained from collecting Kresnik Kristall
